title: Oxlint Policy Refresh Implementation Tasks
principles: Keep generic, Effect-specific and TaxKit-specific lint policy under separate owners.
Fix owned findings without suppressions, unsafe assertions, type laundering or behaviour changes.
Match each claim with focused local proof and hosted pull-request checks.

globalVerification.commitPolicy: Commit only after focused lint tests, canonical documentation checks and full repository verification pass.
evidenceRequired: Accepted and rejected executable lint fixtures

downstreamArtifactImpact.surface: Lint dependencies, configuration, plugins and tests
downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: bun run test:oxlint and bun run lint
nonClaims: Lint success does not prove package or runtime behaviour beyond checked source patterns.

downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: bun run check:docs and bun run check:runbooks
nonClaims: Historical evidence is preserved and external reference paths are not recorded.

downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: Package type checks, tests, production reachability, packed consumers and Changeset status.
nonClaims: No publication, deployment, provider or external-consumer result is implied.

tasks.title: Refresh and verify TaxKit Oxlint policy
tasks.goal: Run every applicable current shared anti-slop safeguard through TaxKit's ordinary root lint graph.
scope: vendored generic and Effect anti-slop plugins
outputs: all generic and Effect anti-slop rules at error severity
narrow ignore and TypeScript redeclaration policy
focused real-binary fixtures and updated semantic owners
tasks.implementationPrompt: Preserve TaxKit's stricter rules and exact boundary allowlists. Exclude browser, React, content, framework and reference-project policy that TaxKit does not own. Fix findings structurally and do not weaken lint.
qualityAudits: Review every reference rule as shared, already covered, TaxKit-specific or excluded.
Review Effect findings against the strict Effect architecture and installed version.
Review the final diff for broad ignores, weakened severity, unsafe assertions and unrelated generated changes.

parentAudit.basis: Review the lint call graph, fixtures, documentation impact ledger, local verification and hosted Quality result.
parentAudit.recovery: Correct or revert the policy if a rule, scope, finding fix or proof does not match this SPEC.

completionCriteria: All focused and repository checks pass.
The pull-request Quality graph passes on the candidate commit.
The pull request merges safely and origin/main resolves to the merged result.
